name: movie_play
description: Put the movie on: a big screen opens above the desk and plays it, from where the user left off unless from_start. Without a title it plays the current (or only) movie.

name: movie_control
description: Control the movie: pause; resume; seek: to `seconds` from the start, or to a saved spot by `mark` (its name or a few words of it, e.g. 'the big phone call'; puts that spot's movie on if another is); skip: `seconds` forward (negative goes back); volume: set `volume` from 0 to 1 (20% = 0.2; 'pretty low' is about 0.2, mute = 0, all the way up = 1) or change it by `by` ('a bit louder' = 0.15, 'a bit quieter' = -0.15); close: the screen goes away (the place is kept).

mark.description: seek: a saved spot instead of seconds

by.description: volume: up (+) or down (-) from now

name: movie_marks
description: Spots saved in a movie, so the user can jump to a scene by name later. save: `label` = what happens there, in the user's words ('Hildy tears up the contract'), at `seconds` from the start (minute 45 = 2700, 1:12:30 = 4350) or, without seconds, where the movie is now; saving a label that exists moves it. list: the spots in the movie. remove: `label` = which spot. `title` = which movie (default: the one on). To jump to one, use movie_control seek with `mark`.

label.description: save: what happens there; remove: which spot

name: movie_status
description: What's on the movie screen (title, playing or paused, how far in, volume, its saved spots) and the movies there are.
